verifiers.description: Q2 Innovation Project Document Created with Correct Details

validation_config.query:
WITH new_project_doc AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    name,
    description,
    parent_id,
    mime_type,
    created_time,
    trashed
  FROM files
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%q2 innovation project plan%'
    AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
    AND parent_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8Q'
    AND trashed = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM new_project_doc
WHERE LOWER(description) LIKE '%q2 innovation project%'
  AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%strategic initiative planning%'
  AND created_time > '2024-01-27 00:00:00';

verifiers.name: Team Access Permissions Created for Three Team Members
verifiers.description: Team Access Permissions Created for Three Team Members

validation_config.query:
WITH new_project_doc AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM files
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%q2 innovation project plan%'
    AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
    AND parent_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8Q'
    AND trashed = 0
),
team_permissions AS (
  SELECT
    p.file_id,
    u.email,
    p.role,
    p.type,
    p.deleted
  FROM permissions p
  INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
  INNER JOIN new_project_doc npd ON npd.id = p.file_id
  WHERE p.deleted = 0
    AND u.email IN ('sarah.johnson@company.com', 'emily.davis@company.com', 'mike.chen@company.com')

verifiers.description: Channel Email Provisioned

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM channels c
      JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id
      WHERE c.display_name = 'Cross-Platform Sync Board'
        AND t.display_name LIKE '%Data Migration%'
        AND c.email IS NOT NULL
        AND LENGTH(TRIM(c.email)) > 0
        AND c.email LIKE '%@%.teams.ms'
        AND c.soft_delete = 0
    )
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS verification_passed;

  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM channel_members cm
      JOIN channels c ON c.channel_id = cm.channel_id
      JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id
      JOIN teams_users tu ON tu.user_id = cm.user_id
      WHERE c.display_name = 'Cross-Platform Sync Board'
        AND t.display_name LIKE '%Data Migration%'
        AND tu.display_name = 'Alice Johnson'
        AND cm.roles LIKE '%owner%'
        AND c.soft_delete = 0
    )
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS verification_passed;

verifiers.name: Formula Verification Comment Acknowledged
verifiers.description: Formula Verification Comment Acknowledged

  SELECT id
  FROM comments
  WHERE id = '899964F4F85948A99FB77FF1A6'
    AND file_id = 'B8B55526452E467EBFC3FF3D72'
    AND deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM calendars c
                    WHERE c.user_id = 'alice_manager'
                    AND (c.summary LIKE '%Team%Archived%'
                      OR c.summary LIKE '%Team%Archive%'
                      OR c.summary LIKE '%archived%'

                      JOIN scopes s ON a.scope_id = s.id

verifiers.name: hr_case_task_creation_verifier
verifiers.description: Verifies that exactly one hr_case_task record was created with hr_case_task_id = 150, linked to parent case ID 1, in ready status, assigned to HR Service Desk (group_id = 4), with task_type = 'checklist', active flag set to true, and the correct short description.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS result FROM hr_case_task hct LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON hct.assignment_group = ug.group_id WHERE hct.hr_case_task_id = 150 AND hct.parent_case = 1 AND hct.status = 'ready' AND hct.task_type = 'checklist' AND hct.active = true AND hct.short_description = 'Initial Policy Documentation Review' AND ug.group_id = 4 AND ug.name = 'HR Service Desk' AND hct.org_id = 1;

verifiers.name: checklist_items_creation_verifier
verifiers.description: Verifies that exactly three checklist items (checklist_id 91, 92, 93) were created for case_task_id = 150, all unchecked, with the correct item descriptions.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS result FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) as total_items, SUM(CASE WHEN checklist_id = 91 AND checklist_item_description = 'Download Policy PDF' AND checked = false AND case_task_id = 150 AND org_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as item1, SUM(CASE WHEN checklist_id = 92 AND checklist_item_description = 'Compare with current version' AND checked = false AND case_task_id = 150 AND org_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as item2, SUM(CASE WHEN checklist_id = 93 AND checklist_item_description = 'Update Case Worknotes' AND checked = false AND case_task_id = 150 AND org_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as item3 FROM checklist WHERE case_task_id = 150 ) subquery WHERE total_items = 3 AND item1 = 1 AND item2 = 1 AND item3 = 1;

verifiers.name: combined_data_integrity_verifier
verifiers.description: Comprehensive verifier confirming that one HR case task, three checklist items, and one survey instance were created with correct attributes and relationships. Returns 1 only if all validations succeed.

validation_config.query: SELECT CASE WHEN task_count = 1 AND checklist_count = 3 AND survey_instance_count = 1 AND task_valid = 1 AND all_checklists_valid = 3 AND survey_valid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS result FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_task WHERE hr_case_task_id = 150) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_task hct LEFT JOIN user_group ug ON hct.assignment_group = ug.group_id WHERE hct.hr_case_task_id = 150 AND hct.parent_case = 1 AND hct.status = 'ready' AND hct.task_type = 'checklist' AND hct.active = true AND hct.short_description = 'Initial Policy Documentation Review' AND ug.group_id = 4 AND hct.org_id = 1) AS task_valid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist WHERE case_task_id = 150) AS checklist_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist WHERE case_task_id = 150 AND checklist_id IN (91, 92, 93) AND checked = false AND org_id = 1 AND ( (checklist_id = 91 AND checklist_item_description = 'Download Policy PDF') OR (checklist_id = 92 AND checklist_item_description = 'Compare with current version') OR (checklist_id = 93 AND checklist_item_description = 'Update Case Worknotes') )) AS all_checklists_valid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_instance WHERE survey_instance_id = 26) AS survey_instance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_instance WHERE survey_instance_id = 26 AND survey_id = 1 AND assigned_to = 2 AND case_task_id = 150 AND org_id = 1 AND answer_1 IS NULL AND answer_2 IS NULL AND answer_3 IS NULL AND answer_4 IS NULL AND answer_5 IS NULL) AS survey_valid ) AS verification_results;

verifiers.name: referential_integrity_verifier
verifiers.description: Validates all foreign key relationships: HR case task references a valid parent case and assignment group Checklist items reference a valid case task Survey instance references a valid survey, user, and case task

validation_config.query: SELECT CASE WHEN task_parent_exists = 1 AND task_group_exists = 1 AND all_checklists_ref_valid = 3 AND survey_refs_valid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS result FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_task hct INNER JOIN hr_case hc ON hct.parent_case = hc.hr_case_id WHERE hct.hr_case_task_id = 150 AND hc.hr_case_id = 1) AS task_parent_exists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_task hct INNER JOIN user_group ug ON hct.assignment_group = ug.group_id WHERE hct.hr_case_task_id = 150 AND ug.group_id = 4) AS task_group_exists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist c INNER JOIN hr_case_task hct ON c.case_task_id = hct.hr_case_task_id WHERE c.checklist_id IN (91, 92, 93) AND hct.hr_case_task_id = 150) AS all_checklists_ref_valid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_instance si INNER JOIN survey s ON si.survey_id = s.survey_id INNER JOIN user u ON si.assigned_to = u.user_id INNER JOIN hr_case_task hct ON si.case_task_id = hct.hr_case_task_id WHERE si.survey_instance_id = 26 AND s.survey_id = 1 AND u.user_id = 2 AND hct.hr_case_task_id = 150) AS survey_refs_valid ) AS integrity_check;

verifiers.name: comprehensive_cross_table_state_verification
verifiers.description: Comprehensive verifier that confirms updates across hr_case_task, hr_case, hr_profile, and user tables all succeeded.

validation_config.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_case_task WHERE hr_case_task_id = 26 AND status = 'closed_complete' AND parent_case = 11) = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_case WHERE hr_case_id = 11 AND status = 'work_in_progress' AND priority = 'high' AND assigned_to = 4) = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_profile WHERE hr_profile_id = 21 AND position = 'Administration' AND location_type = 'Office Based' AND national_tax_id = 'TAX-12-0021') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT() FROM user WHERE user_id = 21 AND phone = '+12125550199') = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS all_updates_verified;

verifiers.name: audit_trail_verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that all updated records have updated_at timestamps later than their previous baseline, confirming persistence.

validation_config.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_case_task WHERE hr_case_task_id = 26 AND updated_at > '2023-02-15T10:05:00') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_case WHERE hr_case_id = 11 AND updated_at > '2023-02-15T10:00:00') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_profile WHERE hr_profile_id = 21 AND updated_at > '2023-01-01T00:00:00') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT() FROM user WHERE user_id = 21 AND updated_at > '2025-08-27T15:34:35') = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS audit_trail_verified;

verifiers.name: referential_integrity_verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that all foreign key relationships remain intact after updates across tasks, cases, profiles, and users.

validation_config.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_case_task hct INNER JOIN hr_case hc ON hct.parent_case = hc.hr_case_id WHERE hct.hr_case_task_id = 26 AND hc.hr_case_id = 11) = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT() FROM hr_case hc INNER JOIN user u ON hc.assigned_to = u.user_id WHERE hc.hr_case_id = 11 AND u.user_id = 4 AND u.first_name = 'Joanne' AND u.last_name = 'Simpson') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_profile hp INNER JOIN user u ON hp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE hp.hr_profile_id = 21 AND u.user_id = 21 AND u.first_name = 'Andrew' AND u.last_name = 'Bell') = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS referential_integrity_verified;

verifiers.name: Verify Language Settings and Delegate Created
verifiers.description: Verifies that language is set to en-US and delegate finance.lead@company.com exists for user_002.

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN language_set >= 1 AND delegate_exists >= 1 
    THEN 1 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM language_settings 
     WHERE user_id = 'user_002' 
       AND display_language LIKE '%en%US%') AS language_set,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delegates 
     WHERE user_id = 'user_002' 
       AND delegate_email = 'finance.lead@company.com') AS delegate_exists
);

verifiers.name: Verify Executive and Product Labels Created
verifiers.description: Verifies that two labels were created for user_002: Executive Priority with red color and Product Updates with purple color.

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN exec_label >= 1 AND product_label >= 1 
    THEN 1 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labels 
     WHERE user_id = 'user_002' 
       AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%executive%'
       AND color_json IS NOT NULL
       AND JSON_EXTRACT(color_json, '$.backgroundColor') IN ('#fb4c2f')) AS exec_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labels 
     WHERE user_id = 'user_002' 
       AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%product%'
       AND color_json IS NOT NULL
       AND JSON_EXTRACT(color_json, '$.backgroundColor') IN ('#a479e2')) AS product_label
);

verifiers.name: Verify IMAP Enabled and POP Disabled
verifiers.description: Verifies that IMAP is enabled with auto-expunge for user_002 and POP access is disabled.

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN imap_enabled >= 1 AND pop_disabled >= 1 
    THEN 1 
    ELSE 0 
  END AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM imap_settings 
     WHERE user_id = 'user_002' 
       AND enabled IN (1, true, 'true')
       AND auto_expunge IN (1, true, 'true')) AS imap_enabled,

verifiers.name: Filter exists for project-team + roadmap/milestone/delivery
verifiers.description: Ensures that exactly ONE filter exists where the filter criteria includes project-team@company.com or any of the required subjects, and the filter action applies the correct label.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filters f
JOIN labels l ON l.id = JSON_EXTRACT(f.action_json, '$.addLabelIds[0]')
WHERE f.user_id = 'user_001'
  AND l.name = 'Project Compliance Records'
  AND (

     OR f.criteria_json LIKE '%roadmap%'
     OR f.criteria_json LIKE '%milestone%'
     OR f.criteria_json LIKE '%delivery%'
      );

verifiers.name: Engineering Team Group and Alex Rodriguez Permissions Removed
verifiers.description: Engineering Team Group and Alex Rodriguez Permissions Removed

validation_config.query:
WITH engineering_team_permission AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM permissions
  WHERE id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P91'
),
alex_rodriguez_permission AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM permissions
  WHERE id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P95'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engineering_team_permission) = 0
     AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alex_rodriguez_permission) = 0
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS cnt;

verifiers.name: Security Review Comment Updated and Reorganization Comment Created
verifiers.description: Security Review Comment Updated and Reorganization Comment Created

validation_config.query:
WITH updated_implementation_comment AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    file_id,
    content,
    modified_time,
    deleted
  FROM comments
  WHERE id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P96'
    AND file_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8R'
    AND deleted = 0
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%security review completed%'
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%access governance measures applied%'
),
reorganization_comment AS (
  SELECT
    file_id,
    content,
    author_id,
    deleted
  FROM comments
  WHERE file_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8R'
    AND deleted = 0
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%engineering drive reorganization completed%'
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%drive-level sharing restrictions enabled%'
    AND author_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P7W'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated_implementation_comment) >= 1
     AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reorganization_comment) >= 1
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS cnt;

                    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cm.user_id IN
                      ('james.wilson','john.davis','alice.johnson','bob.smith')
                      THEN cm.user_id END) = 4

                    WHERE ch.topic = 'Incident Response Triage'
                    AND ch.chat_type = 'group';

verifiers.name: techcorp_incident_triage_kickoff_message_posted
verifiers.description: Verify that a kickoff message was posted in the 'Incident Response Triage' chat describing P1/P2 usage and referencing Planner and OneNote.

validation_config.query:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    FROM chats ch JOIN chat_messages m ON ch.chat_id = m.chat_id
                    WHERE ch.topic = 'Incident Response Triage'
                    AND LOWER(m.body_json) LIKE '%hub%'
                    AND LOWER(m.body_json) LIKE '%p1%'
                    AND LOWER(m.body_json) LIKE '%p2%'
                    AND LOWER(m.body_json) LIKE '%production%issue%';

verifiers.name: techcorp_incident_triage_kickoff_message_pinned
verifiers.description: Verify that the kickoff message in the 'Incident Response Triage' chat was pinned.

validation_config.query:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    FROM chats ch JOIN chat_messages m ON ch.chat_id = m.chat_id
                    JOIN pinned_chat_messages pcm ON pcm.chat_id = ch.chat_id
                    AND pcm.message_id = m.message_id
                    WHERE ch.topic = 'Incident Response Triage'
                    AND LOWER(m.body_json) LIKE '%hub%'

verifiers.name: Count shortcut files pointing to the "Marketing Presentation" file ID have been deleted
verifiers.description: This verifies that shortcuts were identified and deleted across all drives.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS shortcuts_deleted
FROM files
WHERE is_shortcut = 1
  AND trashed = 1
  AND shortcut_target_id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM files
    WHERE name = 'Marketing Presentation'
  );

verifiers.name: Check if permissions on "Marketing Presentation" file have been revoked for all users except the owner
verifiers.description: Return 1 if only owner has access, return number of permissions otherwise

validation_config.query:
WITH marketing_presentation AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM files
    WHERE name = 'Marketing Presentation'
),
file_permissions AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.role, p.email_address, p.deleted
    FROM permissions p
    WHERE p.file_id IN (SELECT id FROM marketing_presentation) AND p.deleted = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as remaining_permissions
FROM file_permissions;

verifiers.name: Check if "Integrity Reports" folder was created in the same drive as "Marketing Presentation"
verifiers.description: This verifies that the folder was created in the correct drive. Returns 1 (if the folder exists in the correct drive, 0 otherwise)

validation_config.query:
WITH marketing_presentation AS (
    SELECT drive_id
    FROM files
    WHERE name = 'Marketing Presentation'
),
integrity_reports AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS folder_count
    FROM files f
    WHERE f.name = 'Integrity Reports' AND f.mime_type = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' AND f.drive_id IN (SELECT drive_id FROM marketing_presentation)
)
SELECT folder_count
FROM integrity_reports;

verifiers.name: Check if the integrity report file "Marketing_Presentation_Integrity_Report.txt" was created in the "Integrity Reports" folder
verifiers.description: Returns 1 if the report file exists in the Integrity Reports folder, 0 otherwise

validation_config.query: WITH integrity_reports AS ( SELECT id FROM files WHERE name = 'Integrity Reports' AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' ), report_file AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS file_count FROM files f WHERE f.name = 'Marketing_Presentation_Integrity_Report.txt' AND f.mime_type = 'text/plain' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM integrity_reports ir, json_each(f.parent_ids) je WHERE je.value = CAST(ir.id AS TEXT) ) ) SELECT file_count FROM report_file;

verifiers.name: This verifies that a comment was added to the report file and it mentions the email: john.smith@company.com and the domain: company.com

verifiers.name: Count of affected files where Engineering Team has no active permission (deleted or non-existent)
verifiers.description: Confirm that engineering Team Access is Blocked

validation_config.query:
WITH engineering_group AS (
  SELECT id FROM groups WHERE email = 'engineering@company.com'
),
drive_cte AS (
  SELECT id FROM drives WHERE name = 'Engineering Projects'
),
affected_files AS (
  SELECT f.id
  FROM files f
  JOIN drive_cte d ON f.drive_id = d.id
  WHERE f.mime_type IN (
    'application/pdf', 
    'application/msword', 
    'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
  )
  AND f.trashed = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM affected_files af
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM permissions p
  WHERE p.file_id = af.id
  AND p.group_id = (SELECT id FROM engineering_group)
  AND p.deleted = 0
);

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM (SELECT 1 FROM child_incident c JOIN incident p ON c.parent_incident = p.incident_id JOIN incident ch ON c.child_incident = ch.incident_id WHERE c.parent_incident = 'INC_001' AND c.child_incident IN ('INC_057', 'INC_030', 'INC_101') AND p.org_id = ch.org_id AND p.org_id = 'ORG_001' GROUP BY c.parent_incident HAVING COUNT() = 3) AS integrity_check;

verifiers.name: child_incident_mappings_creation
verifiers.description: Verifies that three child incident mappings were created linking INC_057, INC_030, and INC_101 as children of parent incident INC_001.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_incident WHERE parent_incident = 'INC_001' AND child_incident IN ('INC_057', 'INC_030', 'INC_101') AND child_incident_mapping_id IN ('CINC_007', 'CINC_008', 'CINC_009');

verifiers.name: incident_inc_057_status_update
verifiers.description: Verifies that incident INC_057 was updated to on_hold status with Awaiting Problem as the hold reason.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_057' AND status = 'on_hold' AND on_hold_reason = 'Awaiting Problem';

verifiers.name: incident_inc_101_creation
verifiers.description: Verifies that incident INC_101 was created with correct attributes for the post-outage compliance audit.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_101' AND number = 'INC-000101' AND caller_id = 'USER_059' AND assigned_to = 'USER_059' AND short_description = 'Post-Outage Compliance Audit' AND category = 'database' AND status = 'new' AND impact = 'low' AND urgency = 'low' AND priority = 'planning';

verifiers.name: combined_all_operations_validation
verifiers.description: Comprehensive verifier that confirms all database operations were executed successfully, including child mappings, incident update, and incident creation.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT child_incident_mapping_id FROM child_incident WHERE parent_incident = 'INC_001' AND child_incident IN ('INC_057', 'INC_030', 'INC_101') AND child_incident_mapping_id IN ('CINC_007', 'CINC_008', 'CINC_009') UNION ALL SELECT incident_id FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_057' AND status = 'on_hold' AND on_hold_reason = 'Awaiting Problem' UNION ALL SELECT incident_id FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_101' AND number = 'INC-000101' AND caller_id = 'USER_059' AND assigned_to = 'USER_059' AND short_description = 'Post-Outage Compliance Audit' AND status = 'new') AS all_operations;

verifiers.name: parent_child_relationship_integrity
verifiers.description: Verifies that parent incident INC_001 has exactly three child incidents linked to it.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_incident WHERE parent_incident = 'INC_001';

verifiers.name: audit_trail_consistency
verifiers.description: Verifies that all child-incident relationships share the same organization and were created.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM (SELECT 1 FROM child_incident c JOIN incident p ON c.parent_incident = p.incident_id JOIN incident ch ON c.child_incident = ch.incident_id WHERE c.parent_incident = 'INC_001' AND c.child_incident IN ('INC_057', 'INC_030', 'INC_101') AND p.org_id = ch.org_id AND p.org_id = 'ORG_001' GROUP BY c.parent_incident HAVING COUNT() = 3) AS integrity_check;

verifiers.name: Q4 budget Report description
verifiers.description: Check if Q4 budget Report has quarantine in description

    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM files 
            WHERE name LIKE '%Q4 Budget Report%'
            AND description LIKE '%Quarantine%'
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END as q4_budget_report_has_quarantine_in_description;

verifiers.name: Francisco has permission
verifiers.description: Check if Francisco has permission to the Budget report file

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        -- First check if file exists
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM files 
            WHERE name LIKE '%Q4 Budget Report%'
        ) THEN 0  -- File doesn't exist
        
        -- Check if user exists
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM users 
            WHERE email = 'francisco2013@ibm.com'
        ) THEN 0  -- User doesn't exist
        
        -- Check if user has permissions to the file
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM permissions p
            JOIN files f ON p.file_id = f.id
            JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
            WHERE f.name LIKE '%Q4 Budget Report%'
            AND u.email = 'francisco2013@ibm.com'
            AND p.deleted = 0
        ) THEN 1  -- User has permissions
        
        ELSE 0  -- File and user exist, but no permissions
    END as francisco_has_permissions_to_q4_budget_report;

verifiers.name: Comment on Q4 Budget Report file
verifiers.description: Check if there is a comment on the Q4 Budget Report file

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        -- First check if file exists
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM files 
            WHERE name LIKE '%Q4 Budget Report%'
        ) THEN 0  -- File doesn't exist
        
        -- Check if there's a comment with the specific phrase
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM comments c
            JOIN files f ON c.file_id = f.id
            WHERE f.name LIKE '%Q4 Budget Report%'
            AND c.content LIKE '%The file should be treated%'
            AND c.deleted = 0
        ) THEN 1  -- Comment exists with the phrase
        
        ELSE 0  -- File exists but no matching comment
    END as comment_exists_on_q4_budget_report;

verifiers.name: Valid Task Type Verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that the case task was created with a valid task type (checklist) instead of the invalid 'document' type requested by the user, ensuring only allowed task types are used.

verifiers.name: Valid Channel Value Verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that the case was created with a valid source value (self-service, email, phone, chat, walk-in, or web_portal) instead of the invalid 'mobile_app' value requested by the user. Note: The API accepts 'channel' parameter but database stores it in 'source' column.

        ELSE 0

verifiers.name: Project Phoenix file
verifiers.description: Verify that project phoenix file exists

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM files 
            WHERE name LIKE '%Project Phoenix%'
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END as project_phoenix_file_exists;

verifiers.name: Verify file in project phoenix folder
verifiers.description: Verify that there are more than one file in project phoenix folder

validation_config.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        -- First check if Project Phoenix folder exists
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM files 
            WHERE name LIKE '%Project Phoenix%'
            AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'
        ) THEN 0  -- Folder doesn't exist
        
        -- Count files in Project Phoenix folder
        WHEN (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM files f
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM files folder
                WHERE folder.id = f.parent_id
                AND folder.name LIKE '%Project Phoenix%'
                AND folder.mime_type = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'
            )
        ) > 1 THEN 1  -- More than one file in folder
        
        ELSE 0  -- Folder exists but has 0 or 1 file
    END as more_than_one_file_in_project_phoenix_folder;

FROM service_template st

  AND json_extract(st.change_request_values, '$.short_description') = 'Automated transitional support package'
  AND json_extract(st.change_request_values, '$.category') = 'lifecycle-transition'
  AND json_extract(st.change_request_values, '$.config.requires_manager_ack') = 1
  AND json_array_length(

  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM json_each(
              json_extract(st.change_request_values, '$.config.checklist_defaults')

        WHERE value = 'return-equipment'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM json_each(
              json_extract(st.change_request_values, '$.config.checklist_defaults')
             )
        WHERE value = 'handover-process'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM json_each(
              json_extract(st.change_request_values, '$.config.checklist_defaults')

        WHERE value = 'exit-interview'
